About

I am a purpose-driven finance, project management, and sustainability professional passionate about leadership, business strategy, and social impact. With a strong foundation in sports, academics, and continuous learning, I bring discipline, resilience, and strategic thinking to every role I undertake.

My experience spans finance, project management, sales, CSR, and ESG-driven initiatives, contributing to sustainable infrastructure, road safety, and community development. I am passionate about financial transparency, effective project execution, and creating long-term value by aligning business growth with environmental and social responsibility.

Guided by the philosophy, “Learn consciously, earn responsibly, and live meaningfully,” I strive to build a career where business success and positive societal impact go hand in hand.
